title: When I read the Bible, it feels like I’m there—witnessing dust become destiny.
paragraphs: When I read the Bible, it feels like I’m there—witnessing dust become destiny.
Before titles. Before achievements. Before failure.
Life didn’t begin with randomness. It began with breath… given on purpose.
If God shaped the first life with care, what makes you think He rushed yours?
• “Comment ‘FORMED’ if this reminded you who you are.”
